config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "Allow-Out"
        set uuid 2f6b8c1a-0000-51e9-adf1-77660e2ea746
        set srcintf "x1" "dmz" "x2"
        set dstintf "wan1"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "srv-web" "srv-db-very-long-object-name-that-got-wrapped" "srv-extra"
        set service "HTTP" "HTTPS"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set nat enable
    next
    edit 2
        set name "Deny Guests"
        set srcintf "any"
        set dstintf "wan1"
        set srcaddr "Guest Network"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set schedule "always"
        set action deny
    next
    edit 30
        set name "Branch VPN"
        set srcintf "x1" "x2"
        set dstintf "x1" "wan2"
        set srcaddr "branch-net"
        set dstaddr "hq-net"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        unset status
        config replacemsg-override-group
            edit "custom-msgs"
                set group-type utm
            next
        end
        set comments "policy with a nested block"
    next
    edit 41
        set name "No-NAT out"
        set srcintf "dmz"
        set dstintf "wan1"
        set srcaddr "dmz-hosts"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
    next
end
